name: m5stack-cores3
title: M5Stack CoreS3 + Base LAN PoE
notes: ESP32-S3, 16 MB flash, 8 MB quad PSRAM (M5Stack: '8MB Quad', so GPIO35-37 are free). TF slot on the LCD's SPI bus (SCK 36, MOSI 37, MISO 35), CS GPIO4 (LCD CS GPIO3 isn't driven): M5Stack CoreS3 docs, arduino-esp32 m5stack_cores3 variant. W5500 with the Base LAN PoE v1.2: CS 9, RST 7, INT 14 from the ESPHome ethernet docs' CoreS3 example and M5Stack's Base LAN Arduino tutorial. Also fits the CoreS3 SE. Wi-Fi without the base. No LED the firmware can drive.
